description: This source file defines a utility enum 'ShellExecutor' which provides static methods to execute external shell commands asynchronously, capture their output, handle timeouts, and return structured results.

classes.name: ShellExecutor
classes.description: A utility enum providing methods to run shell commands asynchronously, handle output, and manage timeouts.

classes.name: ShellExecutor.ShellResult
classes.description: A struct encapsulating the outcome of executing a shell command, including stdout, stderr, exit code, timeout flag, success status, and error message.

methods.name: runDetailed
methods.description: Executes a shell command with detailed options such as working directory, environment variables, and timeout; returns a ShellResult.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Simplified method to run a command with optional cwd, env, and timeout; returns a Response object indicating success, message, and payload.
